title: Uncovering Implicit Gender Bias in Narratives through Commonsense Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Using a commonsense inference engine (COMeT) to extract implicit attributes, mental states, and motivations of the protagonist in model-generated stories, followed by measuring their associations with lexicon-based stereotypes (Appearance, Intellect, Power, Valence/Arousal, and LIWC categories) and training a classifier to predict protagonist gender from these social inferences.
